---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What's the idea?

A clear description of what you'd like to see added or changed.

## Why?

What problem does this solve, or what does it make easier?

## Which part of the project does this touch?

- [ ] Floorplan parsing / U-Net model
- [ ] Zone / exit / hazard editor
- [ ] Simulation models (specify which: SFM / RVO / Continuum / CA / all)
- [ ] Launcher GUI
- [ ] Docs / README
- [ ] Other

## Possible approach (optional)

If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, sketch it out here. Not required — ideas without a plan are still welcome.
